narrative_vs_numbers.point: Jio Credit AUM surged to Rs. 37,320 crore by Q2 FY27, matching aggressive growth claims.
PAT dropped 51.1% YoY to Rs. 340 crore in Sep 2026 despite revenue growing 73.2%.
Operating cash flow for Mar 2026 was -Rs. 15,439 crore despite reported revenue of Rs. 3,521 crore.

bull: Jio Credit Gross AUM reached Rs. 37,320 crore in Q2 FY27 with 154% YoY growth.
JioBlackRock AMC Closing AUM scaled to Rs. 22,746 crore as of Sep 2026.
Consolidated Shareholders Equity stood strong at Rs. 1,29,595 crore as of Sep 2026.
bear: Free cash flow deteriorated to -Rs. 15,439 crore for the year ended Mar 2026.
Borrowings spiked to Rs. 41,325 crore by Sep 2026 from zero in Mar 2024.
EBITDA margin compressed from 88% in Mar 2023 to 63% in Sep 2026.
